company.description: qlub is a financial technology company that provides payment and ordering systems for restaurants. It develops a system where customers in restaurants can scan a QR code to access a digital menu and pay the bill using a mobile device. The same system can also support bill splitting, tipping, and payment without requiring a separate app. The platform is mainly used in dine-in restaurants, cafes, hotels, and similar venues.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 69 (-14 over 90 days) and market heat at 15 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.statement: Recent headline metadata discusses an IPO or listing, while Crunchbase’s model assigns a 4.42% IPO probability.
